_schema: CozySimHub category hub game registry — DESIGN-SPEC ui-cozy-category-home-20260817-01 §F.3
_notes: Add one object per game: cards, game-switch and JSON-LD ItemList are all data-driven (zero template change).

guideGroups: per-game sidebar/footer chapter data (layout redesign cozy-layout-redesign-20260818-01). The left sidebar and footer key links render ONLY the current game's guideGroups — sandustry pages no longer show Sovereign Tower chapters (P1-03). Group label falls back to .en when the current language is missing.
taglineI18n = first sentence of the game hub page intro (site.json L0 text, not new copy).
badges: spec §A.2 suggested values; where site.json carries a more precise figure the value was aligned and the source recorded in each game's note.
SD badge '97-98% Positive' has no site.json backing -> kept per spec value, marked pending G4 evidence.
videoGame fields (JSON-LD) are L0 facts sourced from site.json pages; url/image are derived at render time.
